name: shimmer-border
title: Shimmer Border
description: A container or button whose border carries a travelling point of accent light (conic gradient on a registered @property, masked to the border). Intensifies on hover and keyboard focus.

name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
description: Pointer-tracked surface spotlight and border glow shared across a grid of cards, so neighbours light at their nearest edges. Keyboard focus gets the same treatment.

name: cursor-follower
title: Cursor Follower
description: Spring-following cursor layer that morphs over data-cursor targets (button, text, link, media). Off for coarse pointers and reduced motion; never hides the native cursor without a fallback.

name: page-transition
title: Page Transition
description: Route transition kit: fade-through, direction-aware slide, clip-reveal and curtain wipe variants, plus a SharedElement helper built on Motion layoutId.

name: dock
title: Dock
description: macOS-style magnifying dock, transform-only and spring-smoothed, with tooltips, roving-focus keyboard navigation that magnifies on focus, and a travelling active indicator.

name: liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass
description: A pane of liquid glass behind any content: backdrop blur and saturation, a lit rim, a highlight that follows the pointer, a lean toward it on a spring that overshoots and settles, and a squish on press. CSS and springs, no WebGL; static glass under reduced motion.
